subject.title: feat(gateway): propagate approvals to ancestor sessions

question: Should an authorized ancestor-session subscriber receive each descendant approval's canonical `sourceSessionKey` in both live events and authoritative reconnect replay?
rationale: The answer defines a permanent cross-session disclosure and client-state contract; implementation mechanics and green tests cannot determine maintainer intent for that boundary.

options.title: Preserve authorized source identity
options.body: Include `sourceSessionKey` per replayed pending record and document that authorized ancestor reviewers may correlate descendant approvals.

options.title: Make approval state source-blind
options.body: Remove descendant source correlation from live events as well as replay so both paths expose only approval state.

options.title: Pause ancestor projection
options.body: Hold this slice until a narrower disclosure model and client contract are designed.

recommendation.title: Preserve authorized source identity
recommendation.body: Include `sourceSessionKey` per replayed pending record and document that authorized ancestor reviewers may correlate descendant approvals.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the durable approval and reviewer-authorization contract on current main and is the strongest history-backed owner for its disclosure semantics.
